name: AbdomenAtlas 3.0 Mini (= AbdomenAtlas 1.1 images)
what: AbdomenAtlas 3.0 Mini, the Hugging Face dataset AbdomenAtlas/AbdomenAtlas3.0Mini, the images of AbdomenAtlas 1.1, gathered from public sets that arXiv 2407.16697 lists in its Table 1; tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: all 40 archives fetched, 9,262 CT volumes in the release, of which the data platform counts 7,649 CTs, and 7,835 subjects qualifying, about 570.7 GB in the source's catalogue (NIfTI); its ids are volumes, not people, so one person can hold two scans; it holds CTSpine1K's 150 MSD-T10 cases and PANORAMA's 274 MSD and NIH cases, and 200 of AMOS22's labelled CTs are its people
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder
how_to_get: spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh hf --collection abdomenatlas3_mini --repo AbdomenAtlas/AbdomenAtlas3.0Mini --include '^image_only/', submitted from the harvest's acquisition folder; the check is FETCH_STATUS.json's unresolved_failures at 0, and, by the manifest's note, 40 tars by LFS sha256 and 9,262 ct.nii.gz to verify.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid abdomenatlas3_mini; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="abdomenatlas3_mini",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
source_status: on_disk in the data platform at bf1432f: fetched 2026-09-23 from Hugging Face in the first tier-1 launch of 2026-09-23; 40/40 archives; 7,649 CTs
